title: Challenge 3 Quiz - Blockchain Infrastructure for RWA

questions.question: What is the primary role of blockchain in Real-World Asset (RWA) projects?
options: To record ownership, transactions and smart contract activity
To eliminate the need for asset managers

questions.question: Which of the following is a key advantage of blockchain technology?
What is a smart contract?
options: A computer program that automatically executes predefined rules on a blockchain

questions.question: Which task can smart contracts automate in an RWA project?
What is the main purpose of a token standard?
options: To define how blockchain tokens operate and interact

questions.question: Which token standard is commonly used for fungible tokens?
What is the role of a blockchain oracle?
options: To provide trusted external data to smart contracts

questions.question: Who is responsible for safeguarding the underlying asset or important legal documents in many RWA projects?
Why is some information stored off-chain instead of directly on the blockchain?
options: Because it may be confidential, large or subject to privacy regulations
Because blockchain cannot store any information
Because off-chain storage is always free

questions.question: Which statement best describes blockchain's role in RWA projects?
options: Blockchain supports ownership records and automation while working alongside legal, financial and operational systems.
